result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I compiled the `codeanalyzer` module and it builds cleanly, but I didn't run any tests or add a new one for this case.

The change is one added condition in `getAllTeams()` in `LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. The remainder branch now reads `if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && ...)`. Unmatched contributors whose latest commit is older than the 180-day threshold are skipped. Configured teams are untouched, so they keep all their members.

A blank latest-commit date already counts as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank input. No extra handling was needed.
